input.prompt:
An open sketchbook lying flat, seen from directly above, with two hand-drawn illustrations comes gently to life like a living illustration. Camera completely static: no zoom, no pan, no rotation; the book, the paper, the page edges and the drawing style stay exactly the same (pencil and colored-pencil hatching and paper grain hold steady, no new details, no text appears).
Very subtle motion only: on the left page (gray pencil drawing) the little string lights twinkle softly one by one, the young man alone on his stool sways gently as he strums his acoustic guitar, and the laptop screen glows faintly; on the right page (colored pencil) the three friends on the rainbow bench breathe softly and smile, the guitars are strummed lightly, the sunset glow shimmers and the clouds drift a tiny bit. Everything else stays perfectly still. Silent.
